neutral.label: Neutral
neutral.note: Her resting face. Let the light and the song do the work.

soft-smile.label: Soft smile
soft-smile.note: Warm closed-mouth smile with lifted brows: the cozy hook.

devagar-slow-blink.label: Devagar
devagar-slow-blink.note: Lazy head tilt and a half smile, slowly. Blink +4 keeps her eyes open; drag blink negative for heavy lids.

sultry-gaze.label: Sultry gaze
sultry-gaze.note: Eyes slide off the lens, brows low, the smallest smile: come closer.

playful-wink.label: Playful wink
playful-wink.note: A one-eye wink on a full smile: the in-joke.

ooh.label: Ooh
ooh.note: Rounded lips on the backing 'ooh', brows lifted.

sing-aaa.label: Sing aaa
sing-aaa.note: Open-mouth vowel on the chorus line, brows up.

longing.label: Longing
longing.note: Brows knit up, eyes drift, a barely-there smile.
